rationale: The workflow already implements the supported optimizations that fit it: a custom job timeout (timeout-minutes: 15), matrix fail-fast (fail-fast: true), and dependency caching via setup-node cache: pnpm. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT experiment (batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) measured savings from adding a timeout where none existed; this job is already bounded, so that transformation is not applicable. Lowering the existing 15-minute timeout lacks representative job-duration history (ci_history measurement is not_a_measured_baseline) and risks false timeouts on valid slow runs, which is a listed contraindication. Other patterns (cancel-stale, change-filter, skip-workflow) are ci_service-scoped or have estimated/limited impact with unverified contraindications for this repository, and none preserve required-check coverage better than the current configuration.
